title: A 30-Day Plan to Test Your Next Career Move
status: Reference assets built and rendered in this batch. Not finished motion graphics.
note: No prior rendered V8 to V13 artwork exists. Every PNG here is a new build from a reusable concept, not a byte-identical reuse.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: PLAN_NOT_RESULT, from the Attachment B spec, rebuilt on the hook's own payoff.
teaching_assets.trigger: It can make you feel productive without answering the decision.
teaching_assets.onscreen: CAREER ACTIVITY CAN MAKE YOU FEEL PRODUCTIVE WITHOUT ANSWERING THE DECISION
teaching_assets.purpose: Names the problem the plan solves, in the hook.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Two lines, then two lines at 1.8s.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the thirty-day proposal.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft impact as the second half lands.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: New hero framework card. The four phases.
teaching_assets.purpose: The hero framework. Returns briefly at each weekly phase.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One word at a time, 0.9s apart. Closing line at 4.0s.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The closing line. Permission to get an inconvenient answer.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 11 seconds first time, 3 seconds on each return.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the setup.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent per word, then a resolve. Or one resolve only.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: HYPOTHESIS, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's own hypothesis stem.
teaching_assets.onscreen: TOO VAGUE: something strategic / TESTABLE: an internal operations-improvement role
teaching_assets.purpose: Turns a vague ambition into something a month can actually test.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Vague version 1.6s, testable version on the reframe, closing line at 4.0s.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 12 seconds. The right column is long and the whole point is that it is specific, so it gets the time rather than a smaller size.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the self-introduction.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft click as the testable version arrives.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: The operations-improvement destination is the script's stated illustration. It is not a real participant story.
teaching_assets.build_note: The follow-on line, then write what would change your mind, is spoken rather than set as a footer. Keeping it on the frame pushed the stack past the caption-safe line, and shrinking the testable column would have defeated the frame's purpose.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: WEEK1, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's four map questions.
teaching_assets.onscreen: What does the role need? / What evidence do I have? / What context would be new? / What still needs verification?
teaching_assets.purpose: The first week, as four questions rather than a reading list.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One at a time, 1.0s apart. Hold the complete set.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the do-not-buy-a-qualification warning.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent when the set completes.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: WEEK2, from the Attachment B spec, using the three questions the script gives verbatim.
teaching_assets.onscreen: What is a difficult ordinary week? / Where do adjacent backgrounds need support? / Which decisions distinguish someone who is ready?
teaching_assets.purpose: Replaces asking for reassurance with asking about the work.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One question at a time, 1.2s apart.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the nobody-owes-you-access line.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent when the set completes. Not one per question.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: A pleasant conversation is not an offer. Nobody owes access, and silence is not proof of rejection. Both stay spoken.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: WEEK3, from the Attachment B spec. Carries the required labelling boundary.
teaching_assets.trigger: Use public, synthetic, or otherwise permitted material.
teaching_assets.onscreen: TRY ONE BOUNDED PIECE / a work sample, not professional experience
teaching_assets.purpose: The third week, with the boundary attached to the same frame rather than left to a footnote.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Headline alone 1.8s, support line at 2.4s. The stamp is present from the first frame.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The stamp and the headline together.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the one-page recommendation questions.
teaching_assets.required_label: A WORK SAMPLE, NOT PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
teaching_assets.evidence_note: Do not recreate a confidential employer process and do not turn the exercise into unpaid operational work for a prospective employer. A simulation shows a way of thinking; it cannot prove results with real customers, real stakes, or a team never led.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: WEEK4, from the Attachment B spec, with the inconclusive outcome the brief requires be kept available.
teaching_assets.trigger: Then choose one of three decisions:
teaching_assets.onscreen: CONTINUE / MODIFY / STOP / and if the evidence is not enough, inconclusive
teaching_assets.purpose: The decision payoff, with inconclusive kept on the frame so it stays a real option.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One row at a time, 1.2s apart. The inconclusive line arrives last, at display weight, after a clear beat.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The inconclusive line. It is not a footnote.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the illustration outcomes.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one flat accent per row, or one on the closing line.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: Do not turn uncertainty into a yes because thirty days were spent on it. Inconclusive must remain available.

teaching_assets.trigger: The Capability Formation Field Kit is linked below for a broader evidence-led read of your current position.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the two closing lines.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one warm accent on the URL.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: The support line is the script's own limit. It does not promise that a destination will accept your background.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: Separate Watch Next card. Final visual. Routes to V9, not to unfinished V14 research.
teaching_assets.trigger: For a closer look at separating useful experience from unfamiliar context and actual requirements, watch “How to Change Industries Without Starting Over” next.
teaching_assets.onscreen: WATCH NEXT: HOW TO CHANGE INDUSTRIES WITHOUT STARTING OVER
teaching_assets.purpose: Final visual. Closes the batch loop back to V9.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 14 seconds, through the final spoken line and the closing hold.
teaching_assets.exit: NONE. Final visual. No camera return, no outro.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none, then a natural music fade.
